claim: Among all 1225 three-time/four-Fourier measurement patterns on the seven-cycle, exactly 147 have sharp minimum condition number \(\sqrt{(1+\sqrt{1-h_*})/(1-\sqrt{1-h_*})}\), where \(h_*\) is the smallest root of \(h^3-9h^2/7+(22+3u)h/49-(14+7u)/343=0\), \(u=2\cos(2\pi/7)\); the optimal pairs are precisely the two three-term progressions with step product \(\pm2\).
integrity: Proof uses exact cyclotomic arithmetic and an independently executable finite certificate; numerical values are informational only.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted complex-valued three time/four normalized Fourier measurements on the length-seven cycle. Finite exact certificate; no general-prime, weighted, or phaseless assertion. Potential unindexed historical equivalent remains. No independent validation.
title: Sharp balanced mixed time–Fourier sampling on the seven-cycle
